# eos

> llms.txt for the eos repository (embeddedos-org/eos).
> Status: the EmbeddedOS kernel and services — the core
> platform every other repo in the org builds on.

eos is the operating system itself: kernel, HAL, drivers, and
system services (security, networking, filesystem, OTA) for
constrained MCU targets, with board support defined per target
and a host build for development and testing.
